false_positives.title: stat() failure after a successful write deletes the uploaded file
false_positives.description: writeFile and stat are in the same try block; if stat throws after a successful write, the catch unconditionally deletes the file. The cleanup comment shows it was designed for write failures only. Fix: scope the delete-on-failure try to writeFile alone and move stat after, or drop stat and use fileBuffer.length instead.
